name: Neon Blue
tagline: Test decisions on simulated audiences before you spend
description: Neon Blue builds simulations of human behavior. It creates simulated audiences of your customers and market, grounded in real interview and survey data, so you can test pricing, product, creative and UI decisions before you spend. When you want to go deeper, follow up with live AI interviews with real people. Marketing, product and growth teams use it to check a price change, a concept or an ad before committing budget, and investment teams use the consumer answers as inputs to their models.
